svg.title: Book Tracker application architecture and trust boundaries
svg.desc: A managed delivery layer serves the web app and published profile pages. The browser uses managed identity and owner-scoped data permissions. Backend services handle privileged operations and external integrations. Background jobs process lifecycle events and deferred work.
